purpose: Explain integrated gateway and direct API Web AI, Smart complete-JSON context routing, read-only Project inspection, conversation memory, Shadow Preview, and source-change boundaries.
display_lines: Web AI uses the provider and Python-capable model selected in Config Web AI, through a gateway or direct API.
Every approved question starts with the compact Project handoff; Smart Context adds only relevant complete-JSON routing evidence instead of sending the whole file.
Inspect Project permits bounded read-only source tools so generated evidence can be verified against exact source.
Review the per-request context summary and cloud disclosure before approving transmission; source changes remain governed locally.
